# Song of Solomon Chapter 8 -- Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-12

This log records all verses in Song of Solomon Chapter 8 where the three translators significantly diverged.

---

## 8:6 — "flame of YAH" vs. "flame of the LORD" vs. "mighty flame"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "a-flame-of-YAH" | Preserves divine name |
| LOGOS | "the very flame of the LORD" | Explicit divine reference |
| PNEUMA | "the brightest kind of flame" | Superlative reading |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "a mighty flame" — preserves intensity, defers theological debate to guide.

---

## 8:12 — "my vineyard is before me" vs. "mine to give"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "my-vineyard, my-own, is before-me" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "My vineyard, my very own, is before me" | Emphatic |
| PNEUMA | "my own vineyard is mine to give" | Autonomy interpretation |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted PNEUMA — captures the woman's agency.

**Status:** All resolved.
